name: Kodak UltraMax 400
source: Kodak Alaris, KODAK ULTRA MAX 400 Film, publication E-7023 (February 2016)

notes.characteristic: Daylight exposure, process C-41, Status M densitometry, Log H Ref -1.44.
notes.sensitivity: Daylight, effective exposure 1/100 s, Status M, density 0.2 above D-min, sensitivity = 1/exposure (erg/cm2).
notes.dye_density: Process C-41, diffuse spectral density, typical densities for a midscale neutral subject (dashed) and D-min (no per-dye curves published).

grain.note: Print Grain Index (not rms granularity): diffuse-printing illumination, 14 in viewing distance; 25 is the visual threshold, 4 units one just-noticeable difference.
